detail: Full summary: Field claim 'pending-posts only drains on startup' is stale: the 60s periodic drain shipped in v1.24.0 and is in 2.0.0. Their stuck entries are explained by drain-loss (invalid entry_type → dropped, now #45-fixed) or by hooks writing to a worktree-local .twining that no server drains — the worktree-orphan hypothesis needs field confirmation (noted on #45).
